reviewed_by: Claude: harness goal one-shot transient retry, focused harness goal/transport selection
reason: A running harness goal paused on its first failed turn because _account_terminal_chat_usage_once wrote the goal PAUSED with the turn's error, even when the vendor transport simply dropped. Harness turn failures are now classified (new HarnessTransportClosedError for a vendor process/stream that ended; unresponsive app-server; connection errors; retryable HTTP statuses; Codex connection/stream/rate-limit/server error kinds); a transient failure of a running, unheld goal keeps it running with the #1298 provider_auto_retry mark and the idle-goal reconciler continues it once. Select the new retry suite (classification table, one continuation, second-failure pause, completed-turn and resume clearing, non-transient/stop/shutdown/hold/paused cases, real subprocess reader exit vs malformed reply), the harness goal suite, the harness turn lifecycle, Codex/Claude transport and turn outcome suites, adapter tests, and the test_harnesses.py failure, transport-loss and shutdown cases.
exclusions: No UI, setting, or provider change: frontend, Playwright and native layers are empty and the settings assistant is unchanged. Native provider retry (chat.py) is unchanged. Other test_harnesses.py cases do not exercise turn failure settlement; test_knowledge_access_change_refreshes_fixed_gateway_catalog and test_browser_attachment_refreshes_catalog_without_replacing_native_thread fail identically on origin/main (HarnessInstructionContextChanged) and are not selected. No full-suite approval.
